description: React component for managing starter prompts in a chat flow, including UI for adding/removing prompts, saving prompts via API, and handling state and side effects.

methods.name: addInputField
methods.description: Adds a new prompt input field to the list.

methods.name: removeInputFields
methods.description: Removes a prompt input field at the specified index.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles change event for prompt input fields.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Saves the current prompts to the backend API and updates the chat flow.
